choose.en: You may choose whichever book you like.
choose.zh: 你可以选择任何你喜欢的书。

christmas.en: Tom and I've decided not to go to Australia for Christmas this year.
christmas.zh: 我和汤姆决定今年圣诞节不去澳大利亚了。

cold.en: My fingers are so numb with cold that I can't play the piano.
cold.zh: 我的手指冻僵了，以至于无法弹钢琴了。

complex.en: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?
complex.zh: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？

calm.en: I was calm until I saw the syringe.
calm.zh: 看到针管儿之前我一直都很淡定。

contact.en: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
contact.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。

clock.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
clock.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

choice.en: Because of the storm, we had no choice but to stay at home.
choice.zh: 因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

crazy.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
crazy.zh: 你是怎么想到这么疯狂的主意的？

control.en: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
control.zh: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

count.en: Tom closed his eyes and began to count sheep.
count.zh: 汤姆闭上了眼睛开始数羊。

closet.en: Tom hung his jacket in the hall closet.
closet.zh: 汤姆把夹克挂在大厅衣柜里。

completely.en: The leaves of the trees in the garden have turned completely red.
completely.zh: 花园里树上的叶子已经完全变红了。

comfortable.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.

cap.en: I paid ten dollars for this cap.
cap.zh: 我付了十美元买这顶帽子。

chance.en: I hope I will have a chance to see you next time I'm in New York.
chance.zh: 希望下次我在纽约还可以有机会见到你。

camera.en: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
camera.zh: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。

clever.en: He looks like a clever boy.
clever.zh: 他看起来像是个聪明的男孩。

cake.en: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
cake.zh: 蛋糕应该差不多可以出炉了。

coat.en: That coat may have cost a lot of money, but it's worth it.
coat.zh: 那件大衣可能需要很多钱，但它值得。

conservative.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
conservative.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。

coincidence.en: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.
coincidence.zh: 汤姆不认为这是一个巧合。

church.en: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
church.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。

cough.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
cough.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

cigarette.en: He stopped for a quick cigarette.

captain.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
captain.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

chicken.en: The child has a case of chicken pox.

chess.en: We often played chess after school.
chess.zh: 我们常常在放学后下棋。

club.en: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
club.zh: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个俱乐部的成员。

careless.en: Tom told me he'd been careless.
careless.zh: 汤姆告诉我他一直很粗心。

childish.en: His way of thinking is very childish.

cheese.en: My mother made us cheese sandwiches for lunch.
cheese.zh: 妈妈为我们做了乳酪三明治当午餐。

courage.en: I couldn't help but be impressed by Tom's courage.
courage.zh: 汤姆的勇气给我留下了深刻印象。

course.en: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
course.zh: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。

couch.en: A couch potato is something that I don't want to be.
couch.zh: 我不想成为整天泡在沙发上看电视的人。

cash.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
cash.zh: 汤姆把装满现金的信封递给玛丽。

couple.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
couple.zh: 一些航班由于地震被延误了。

complain.en: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
complain.zh: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。

consider.en: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
consider.zh: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。

carpet.en: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
carpet.zh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

color.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
color.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

collect.en: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

contain.en: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
contain.zh: 自来水有可能含有氯、铅等有害物质。

coward.en: She resented being called a coward.
coward.zh: 她对被称为懦夫很反感。

climb.en: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
climb.zh: 我认为在有风暴的时候里登山很危险。

common.en: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
common.zh: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

concert.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
concert.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

cream.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll give you a kiss.
cream.zh: 如果你买给我冰淇淋，我就亲你一下。

consent.en: We will only consent on that condition.
consent.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

coach.en: I knew Tom would be a good basketball coach. That's why I hired him.
coach.zh: 我知道汤姆会成为一位优秀的篮球教练。这就是为什么我聘用了他。

candle.en: When the lights went out, Tom lit a candle.
candle.zh: 灯灭了，汤姆点起了蜡烛。

cancer.en: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
cancer.zh: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。

clothing.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
clothing.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

cross.en: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
cross.zh: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

correct.en: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
correct.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

comment.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
comment.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

concern.zh: 你的问题和我没有关系。

chocolate.en: Does that chocolate bar have nuts in it?
chocolate.zh: 那块巧克力里面有坚果吗？

composer.zh: 他是一位著名的作曲家。

chemistry.en: I majored in chemistry at the university.

childhood.en: When I heard that song, it reminded me of my childhood.
childhood.zh: 我一听到那首歌，就想起来我小的时候。

candy.en: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
candy.zh: 我不论甚么时候都不该让汤姆吃那么多糖。

content.en: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
content.zh: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

castle.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
castle.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

contract.en: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
contract.zh: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

cloth.en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
cloth.zh: 她买了六码的布做衣服。

cheek.en: Tom kissed Mary on the cheek.

curious.en: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."
curious.zh: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”

courageous.en: Tom is very courageous, isn't he?

committee.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
committee.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

clearly.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
clearly.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

coal.en: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
coal.zh: 澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

cell.en: "Have you seen my cell phone?" "It's on the table."
cell.zh: "你有看到我的手机吗?" "它在桌子上。"

character.en: Who's your favorite character in this book?
character.zh: 你最喜欢这本书中的哪个角色？

complete.en: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
complete.zh: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。

certain.en: I'm certain that Tom is the only one who won't do that.
certain.zh: 我确信汤姆是唯一不会那么做的人。

confidence.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
confidence.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

cupboard.en: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
cupboard.zh: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。

cancel.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.
cancel.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。

cruel.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
cruel.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。

crush.en: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.

cause.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

convenient.en: I think you will find it convenient to put a short-cut on the desktop.
convenient.zh: 我想你迟早会知道在桌面建立一个快捷方式是有多方便。

claim.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
claim.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

condition.en: We will only consent on that condition.
condition.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

competent.en: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
competent.zh: 有人说你是个很有能力的人。

central.en: Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to Central Park?
central.zh: 不好意思，请问到中央公园要怎么走?

customer.en: We're looking for someone who has experience in customer service.
customer.zh: 我们正在寻找具有客服工作经验的人。

citizen.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
citizen.zh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

confident.en: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
confident.zh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。

chairman.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
chairman.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

creature.en: Tom says that he's a creature of habit.
creature.zh: 汤姆说他是习惯的产物。

cousin.en: He isn't my brother. He's my cousin.
cousin.zh: 他不是我的兄弟。他是我的表弟。

ceiling.en: There's a big fly on the ceiling.
ceiling.zh: 有一只大苍蝇在天花板上。

cottage.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
cottage.zh: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。

coast.en: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
coast.zh: 大部分的学生来自西海岸。

cliff.en: I nearly fell off the cliff.
cliff.zh: 我差点从悬崖上掉下去。

clown.en: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
clown.zh: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。

cafeteria.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
cafeteria.zh: 餐厅的饭很便宜，而且很好吃。

cart.en: Don't put the cart before the horse.
cart.zh: 不要把马车放在马的前面。

conference.en: "Why are you going to Japan?" "To attend a conference in Tokyo."
conference.zh: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”

crime.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
crime.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。

connection.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
connection.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

conform.en: We must conform to the rules.

counter.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
counter.zh: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？

crowd.en: I heard someone in the crowd outside the station call my name.
crowd.zh: 我听到车站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。

campus.en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
campus.zh: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

charge.en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?
charge.zh: 这附近有没有可以给手机充电的地方？

climate.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
climate.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

cheat.en: It is wrong to cheat at cards.

carpenter.en: The carpenter brought his tools along.

compact.en: She gave me this compact disc.

crawl.en: She knows how to do the crawl.

clinic.en: She went to the Takasu clinic.

capital.en: A capital letter is used at the beginning of a sentence.
capital.zh: 一个句子以一个大写字母开始。

continue.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.
continue.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。

confuse.zh: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。

canoe.en: We went down a river by canoe.
canoe.zh: 我们乘著独木舟向河的下游而行。

compare.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
compare.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

coin.en: I found a coin on the sidewalk.
coin.zh: 我在人行道上发现了一枚硬币。

compliment.en: I'll take that as a compliment.

capacity.en: The room has a seating capacity of 200.

criminal.en: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
criminal.zh: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

construction.en: A new school building is under construction.
construction.zh: 一座新的教学楼正在建设。

consult.en: I don't know who to consult with.
consult.zh: 我不知道该和谁商量好。

commute.en: Do you commute to school by bus?

conscience.en: Do you have a guilty conscience?

cozy.en: He lives in a cozy little house.
cozy.zh: 他住在一个舒适的小房子里。

century.en: Islam first reached China about the middle of the 7th century.
century.zh: 伊斯兰教大约在七世纪中传到中国。

column.zh: 我发现这个专栏很有趣。

calendar.en: She hung the calendar on the wall.

chip.en: Tom baked some chocolate chip cookies.
chip.zh: 汤姆烤了些巧克力脆饼。

compass.en: Compass needles point to the north.
compass.zh: 指南针的指针指向北边。

complaint.en: There is no cause for complaint.

currently.en: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.
currently.zh: 目前哈里发塔是世界上最高的摩天大楼。

celebrate.en: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
celebrate.zh: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

council.en: You should run for city council.
council.zh: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。

cradle.en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.

comb.en: Comb your hair before you go out.
comb.zh: 在你出门之前，把你的头发梳一梳。

command.en: She has a good command of English though she was brought up in Japan.
command.zh: 虽然她在日本被抚养长大，但是她精通英语。

chief.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
chief.zh: 我认识了这位行政长官。

cow.en: I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.
cow.zh: 我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人。

chimney.en: Smoke is rising from the chimney.

cabinet.en: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.

cord.en: This extension cord is too short.

cave.en: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."
cave.zh: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”

conscious.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
conscious.zh: 战士知道自己的力量和弱点。

cabin.en: The little cabin was bathed in moonlight.
cabin.zh: 小木屋沐浴在月光之中。

compromise.en: We tried to come to a compromise with them.

capable.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
capable.zh: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

cure.en: There aren't any medicines that can cure this disease.
cure.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。

cynical.en: People grow more cynical with age.
cynical.zh: 人会随著年龄的增长而更加地玩世不恭。

clerk.en: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
clerk.zh: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

cope.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
cope.zh: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。

cherry.en: This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.

closely.en: If you listen closely enough you'll be able to hear it.
closely.zh: 靠近一点听，你就会听到了。

conclusion.en: Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
conclusion.zh: 汤姆得出无论他做什么，玛丽都不会喜欢的结论。

consecutive.en: It snowed for ten consecutive days.

chapter.en: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.
chapter.zh: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。

curtain.en: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
curtain.zh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

ceremony.en: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
ceremony.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。

crash.en: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
crash.zh: 他的妻子在医院里因为她在一场车祸中受伤了。

criticism.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
criticism.zh: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。

compound.en: Do you know what compound words are?
compound.zh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？

communication.en: English is a means of communication.
communication.zh: 英语是一种沟通的手段。

confirm.en: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
confirm.zh: 我既不能确认也不能否定。

collection.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
collection.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

crew.en: Modern ships only need a small crew.
crew.zh: 现代船只只需要一小组的船员。

consideration.en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
consideration.zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

calculator.en: The batteries in my calculator are dead.
calculator.zh: 我计算机的电池没电了。

classical.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.
classical.zh: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

composition.en: I had my composition corrected by the teacher.
composition.zh: 我把我的作文拿给老师订正。

constant.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
constant.zh: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。

culture.en: The students are talking about language and culture.
culture.zh: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。

convince.en: Tom told Mary not to waste her time trying to convince John to help.
convince.zh: 汤姆对玛丽说，不要浪费时间去说服约翰来帮忙。

conduct.en: One must be responsible for one's conduct.
conduct.zh: 人要为自己的行为负责。

convey.en: Wires are used to convey electricity.

critical.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
critical.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

concentrate.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
concentrate.zh: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。

crisis.en: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
crisis.zh: 在危险的时候你必须跟你的老师联系。

current.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.

colony.en: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.
colony.zh: 有人说中国像是俄国的殖民地。

conceive.en: I can't conceive of living without him.
conceive.zh: 我无法想像生命中没有他。

concrete.en: Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.
concrete.zh: 我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。

canal.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
canal.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。

cycle.en: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
cycle.zh: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。

considerate.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
considerate.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

continent.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
continent.zh: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

cage.en: He thought that it was like a bird cage.

cotton.en: Someday I'll buy a cotton candy machine.
cotton.zh: 有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。

cargo.en: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.

conspicuous.en: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
conspicuous.zh: 他额头上的疤痕很醒目。

cheer.en: The situation is improving, so cheer up!
cheer.zh: 情况正在改善，所以振作起来！

conceal.zh: 汤姆不能掩饰他的失望。

communicate.en: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
communicate.zh: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

concise.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
concise.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

consume.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.

chest.en: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
chest.zh: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。

comparison.en: In comparison with Tokyo, London is small.

contest.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
contest.zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。

constitution.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

competition.en: I participated in a photography competition.
competition.zh: 我参加了一个摄影比赛。

court.en: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
court.zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

consumption.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
consumption.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。

community.en: Do you take part in any community activities?

civil.en: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.
civil.zh: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。

cheerful.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
cheerful.zh: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。

charm.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
charm.zh: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。

combination.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
combination.zh: 融合爵士是摇滚乐与爵士乐的融合。

capture.en: They would capture as many people as possible.
capture.zh: 他们会尽可能地抓更多的人。

candidate.en: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
candidate.zh: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。

circle.en: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
circle.zh: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。

comprehend.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
comprehend.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

cassette.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
cassette.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

cricket.en: A caged cricket eats just as much as a free cricket.
cricket.zh: 笼子里的蟋蟀吃得跟野生的蟋蟀一样多。

chill.en: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
chill.zh: 在你侍酒前最好先将白葡萄酒冷却一下。

camel.en: The camel can go a long time without water and food.
camel.zh: 骆驼可以撑很久不吃不喝。

charity.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
charity.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

connect.en: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?
connect.zh: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？

contrary.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
contrary.zh: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。

chalk.en: Take this piece of chalk and write on the blackboard.
chalk.zh: 拿起这支粉笔，在黑板上写字。

cartridge.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
cartridge.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

construct.en: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
construct.zh: 读完他的书后，我觉得我可以构建一栋房子。

crane.en: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
crane.zh: 不像狗, 这只鹤从来没有梦想过飞翔。

cent.en: These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
cent.zh: 这些纸板盒是百分之百可回收的。

christ.en: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
christ.zh: 我们这里以耶稣基督和查理斯国王之名。

complicated.en: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
complicated.zh: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。

characteristic.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

calculation.en: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
calculation.zh: 根据我的估计，她现在应该在印度了。

compute.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
compute.zh: 科学家们可以很容易地计算出行星之间的距离。

conventional.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
conventional.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

circus.en: At the age of six, I was taken to a circus for the first time.
circus.zh: 在我六岁的时候，我第一次被带去看马戏。

chemical.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
chemical.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

conflict.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
conflict.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

considerable.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
considerable.zh: 已经花费了很多的时间和精力。

camp.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
camp.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

champion.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
champion.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

coincide.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
coincide.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

competitive.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
competitive.zh: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。
